The scientific content is unchanged: the author RHS (fMGG_synthesis.m, unmodified), the eliminated set (21 complexes), the kept-dynamic set (7 enzyme-bound complexes + free MetAMP + free GlyAMP), the closure equations (0 = dC_i/dt rows taken verbatim from the author RHS), the cumulative-extent definitions, the registered thresholds (T_A..T_H and the QSSA scaled-residual acceptance 1e-10), the stress conditions S0..S5, and acceptance_criteria.json are all FROZEN and UNTOUCHED. No threshold was relaxed; no failing condition was deleted; no negative concentration was clipped; no invalid root was silently projected; a non-converging root above the registered acceptance still terminates the run as a failure.

revision_1_dae_to_eliminated_ode.what_changed: Retired the singular-mass-matrix DAE harness ('MassSingular','yes') in favour of the mathematically equivalent algebraically eliminated ODE: dynamic states s, algebraic states q = h(s) solved from the registered closure G(s,q)=0 at every RHS evaluation, ds/dt = F(s,h(s)) with F the author RHS restricted to the dynamic rows.
revision_1_dae_to_eliminated_ode.why: The singular-mass DAE is numerically unattainable at the registered tolerances (RelTol 1e-10 / AbsTol 1e-14) in MATLAB R2025b. Full evidence and the step-size-independence measurement are preserved in dae_singular_mass_failure_v1.md.
revision_1_dae_to_eliminated_ode.evidence_error_floor_is_step_size_indepe: see dae_singular_mass_failure_v1.md: with 'MassSingular','yes' the ode15s corrector reaches a step-size-independent error-test plateau of 1.67*RelTol on the algebraic rows with small Jacobian diagonals (GlyRS_ATP, GlyRS_Gly). Cause: the author RHS sums terms up to ~3e6 uM/s, so each eliminated row carries ~1e-9 uM/s of double-precision cancellation noise, and the implied root jitter noise/|J_ii| exceeds RelTol*|C_i| ~ 1e-13. Halving the step does not reduce the plateau (it is a floating-point/error-control floor, not a truncation-error floor). R2025b ode15s exposes no algebraic-state option ('MStates' does not exist).
revision_1_dae_to_eliminated_ode.diagnosis_classification: NUMERICAL_IMPLEMENTATION_LIMITATION, not a scientific QSSA failure. The eliminated formulation removes the jittered algebraic roots from the solver error vector without changing the mathematics: the closure G(s,q)=0 and the dynamic rows F(s,q) are identical to the DAE's.
revision_1_dae_to_eliminated_ode.mathematical_equivalence: index-1 DAE  M y' = f(y) with singular M selecting algebraic rows 0 = g(y_alg) is equivalent to q = h(s) (the implicit-function solution of g) and s' = F(s, h(s)); the eliminated ODE integrates exactly this.

revision_2_free_enzyme_moiety_reconstruc.what_changed: The two FREE enzymes (MetRS, GlyRS) are no longer integrated as independent dynamic states. Each is reconstructed at every RHS evaluation and every output time from its conserved enzyme moiety: free = ePool - sum(kept complexes) - sum(eliminated complexes), where ePool = free + all non-degraded complexes evaluated from the (scaled) author initial values. This is the identical reconstruction already used by consistentStart, by algRows, and by the registered partition-verification closure.
revision_2_free_enzyme_moiety_reconstruc.why: acceptance_criteria.json tier T_G (FROZEN, threshold 1e-8) requires every enzyme-family total to be conserved in EVERY formal run, and authorization A2 is 'exact free-enzyme reconstruction'. Integrating the free enzyme instead (keeping it dynamic) was measured 2026-09-25 to leak ~99% of each pool by t = 1000 s (T_G residual ~0.99): because the QSSA pins the eliminated rows dC_i/dt = 0, enzyme sequestered in the eliminated complexes never returns to the free pool as substrates drain, so the free-enzyme ODE has no restoring flux. Reconstructing free from the conserved moiety makes pool conservation exact by construction (free + kept + eliminated == ePool identically).

revision_3_newton_convergence_scale.what_changed: solveBlock's convergence scale c.refscale is now seeded with the block's physical PRODUCTION scale (max|dC_i/dt| of the author RHS at the author initial values, eliminated complexes zero, free enzyme = full pool), independently re-measured as MetRS 1.650e4 uM/s and GlyRS 1.3125e4 uM/s. Previously refscale was initialised to 1 and only grown by max(refscale, res), so at an already-converged root the target tol = 1e-12*refscale collapsed to 1e-12 ABSOLUTE.
revision_3_newton_convergence_scale.why: At the first grid point t = 1e-4, during ode15s's numerical-Jacobian evaluation, the GlyRS warm-start residual was 1.166e-12 uM/s = 9.4e-17 of the 1.245e4 uM/s production scale (below machine epsilon): the closure was satisfied to round-off, but 1.166e-12 marginally exceeded the buggy 1e-12-absolute target, the feasibility line search could find no step that further reduced a round-off residual, and solveBlock spuriously raised 'root failure ... no feasible improving step'. The run terminated at t = 1e-4 (non-formal RED-S0 smoke, 2026-09-25).
revision_3_newton_convergence_scale.fix: Anchor the scaled residual to the fixed physical production scale, matching the registered QSSA quantity. The Newton convergence target is 1e-12 of the production scale; the registered QSSA acceptance is a scaled residual <= 1e-10 of it (candidate_partition.json verification_result: 'max_scaled_algebraic_residual <= 1e-10 by construction of convergence test; final residuals <= 1e-13 observed'). On a line-search plateau the root is accepted iff res <= 1e-10*refscale (within registered acceptance) and otherwise still raises an error terminating the run. The two 'closure-lost' guards (RHS and output reconstruction) were likewise changed from an arbitrary absolute 1e-6 to the registered scaled acceptance 1e-10*refscale; for GlyRS the old 1e-6 was actually STRICTER than the registered 1.245e-6 and could have spuriously rejected a valid root.
revision_3_newton_convergence_scale.this_is_not_threshold_relaxation: The registered acceptance (scaled <= 1e-10) is unchanged and is now applied consistently. The internal Newton target (scaled 1e-12) remains 100x STRICTER than the registered acceptance. refscale is fixed at the production scale and is never inflated by a transient residual, so the guard cannot drift looser than registered.
